safe_canvas_rule: HUD reflows through the shared aspect-safe layout when the OS window changes size.
startup_rule: Use exact 1920x1080 when the desktop supports it; use decorated 1080p when the work area fits, exact borderless 1080p when taskbar/decorations would force a downscale, and only scale smaller when the desktop itself is below 1080p.
fallback_rule: A 1280x720 desktop keeps an exact 1280x720 borderless client rather than shrinking below the documented minimum.
user_choice_rule: Desktop-fit, bordered, borderless-desktop, and exclusive fullscreen remain explicit alternate presets.
